messages.en: One step at a time — that already counts for a lot.
messages.author: 陳老師

messages.text: 你比自己想像中更接近目標。
messages.en: You are closer than you think.
messages.author: Ms Wong

messages.en: Rest is part of the work. Sleep well tonight.
messages.author: 李老師

messages.en: It does not have to be perfect — just a little clearer than yesterday.

messages.text: 考試是一場展示，不是對你整個人的判決。
messages.author: 林老師

messages.text: 你已經走了很遠。記得為自己喝采。
messages.en: You have already come a long way. Cheer for yourself.

messages.text: 深呼吸。下一題，下一天，你都可以重新開始。
messages.en: Breathe. The next question, the next day — you can begin again.
messages.author: Mr Chan

messages.text: 家人和朋友都在你這邊。你不是一個人。
messages.en: Family and friends are with you. You are not alone.
messages.author: 黃老師
